evals.name: resume-synced-project
evals.prompt: A learner opens a new conversation in an existing textbook project. Project notes record the last exercise and an already approved non-synchronized scratch location in .learning-local.json. The project is synchronized by a cloud provider other than OneDrive. Explain your next actions before extracting a large source archive. Do not execute filesystem or network mutations.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the checkpoint and approved local configuration; validate paths without repeating onboarding or moving learner work.
expectations: Reads and reuses the recorded checkpoint and machine-local scratch configuration.
Does not ask again for the already authorized location.
Distinguishes Git ignore from cloud synchronization and protects durable work.

evals.name: textbook-recall
evals.prompt: Prepare a brief plan, not a completed lesson, for an adult who recognizes words but cannot handwrite them from memory. The input is a textbook page, not a video. The current exercise hides the main answer but still shows it in the sidebar and typed-reference panel. No graded work has been submitted. State how you would teach, assess, and choose the next lesson. Do not browse or change files.
evals.expected_output: Reading-led workflow, whole-page recall concealment, separate capability evidence and provisional next steps.
expectations: Uses reading and source-page context rather than requiring video timestamps.
Hides answer-bearing sidebar and typed references as well as the main answer during recall.
Does not infer mastery or impose a fixed repetition count without evidence.

evals.name: broad-book-onboarding
evals.prompt: Use this skill and my software-course and language-study projects to understand my preferences, help me study this drawing book, and create a repository using my notes naming convention.
evals.expected_output: Necessary setup and one bounded reading unit, or requests for missing sources, followed by a feedback stop.
expectations: Does not prebuild whole-book notes or HTML
Does not transfer subject mastery from previous projects
Keeps artifact completion separate from learner progress

evals.name: explicit-whole-book-outline
evals.prompt: Create a brief chapter-level guide for the whole book in one batch today. Do not make HTML. This does not mean I have read the book.
evals.expected_output: Completes the requested outline once sources are available, without adding lessons or changing learner progress.
expectations: Does not mark chapters as learned
Does not invent unavailable source contents
